name: Wind Drag
description: Quadratic drag relative to a project-wide wind velocity in air of project-wide density.
script:
# F = -½ ρ C_d A |v - w| (v - w), with ρ = global.air_density and w = global.wind
let rel = self.velocity - global.wind
force = -0.5 * global.air_density * param.cd * param.area * norm(rel) * rel
documentation: Uses the global parameters air_density (density) and wind (velocity), defined under Processes ▸ Global Parameters. Every object with this process feels the same wind; changing the globals during a run takes effect at the next step.

tests.name: still object is pushed by the wind
no force when moving with the wind
